name: marketing_skills_ai_agents
description: A set of marketing skills and capabilities tailored for Claude AI Code and AI agents, focused on conversion rate optimization (CRO), copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering to enhance marketing performance.

inputs.name: marketing_data
inputs.description: Raw or processed marketing data including website content, campaign details, keywords, analytics metrics, and campaign goals.

inputs.name: campaign_objectives
inputs.description: Specific marketing goals such as increasing conversion rates, improving SEO rankings, or generating copy.

inputs.name: user_query
inputs.description: Natural language queries or instructions related to marketing tasks.

outputs.name: optimized_marketing_content
outputs.description: Generated or enhanced content such as copywriting outputs or SEO optimizations tailored to the input goals.

outputs.name: analytics_report
outputs.description: Insights and reports derived from marketing analytics data to inform growth decisions.

outputs.name: growth_recommendations
outputs.description: Actionable strategies and growth engineering suggestions based on data analysis and CRO.

patterns: Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) iterative testing and improvement
SEO keyword analysis and content optimization
Data analytics to inform marketing strategy
Growth engineering tactics for scaling marketing impact
steps: Collect and input relevant marketing data and objectives
Analyze data to identify strengths, weaknesses, and opportunities
Apply AI models to generate or optimize marketing content and SEO
Produce analytics reports to support data-driven decisions
Iterate on campaigns using feedback and performance data for CRO
Implement growth engineering strategies to maximize marketing ROI
use_cases: Generating high-conversion marketing copy for digital campaigns
Optimizing website or content SEO to improve search rankings
Analyzing campaign data to produce actionable growth strategies
Automating marketing tasks for AI-driven agents using Claude Code

prompt_templates.name: copywriting_generate
prompt_templates.template: Create persuasive marketing copy for a product that focuses on {product_features} targeting {audience} with the goal of {campaign_objective}.

prompt_templates.name: seo_optimization
prompt_templates.template: Analyze the following content for SEO improvements targeting keywords: {keywords}. Suggest optimizations.

prompt_templates.name: analytics_insights
prompt_templates.template: Provide an analytics summary and growth recommendations based on the following marketing data: {marketing_data}.

prompt_templates.name: cro_testing_plan
prompt_templates.template: Generate a CRO testing plan to improve conversion rate for the campaign focused on {campaign_objective}.
